details:
Hello community, been a while since I tried doing something like this.

My name is cryption, I am 1 of 3 current leaders of the group Laughing Coffin on vrchat, I know "OH MY GOD HOW IS THIS GUY STILL ON THE GAME BAN HIM ADHASIUDHAIDUSH" but I'm not here to do nothing malicious or anything of the sort.

I want to discuss with the VRChat team and it seems like this is the closest thing to that since they ban me everytime they see me in game. So, let me get into it.

I want to talk about age verification, yes we all heard the problems with kids being on VRChat and the predators and such, etc etc. But I have a new angle on this that I have noticed from an experienced point of view.

There are malicious groups that have been more than recently going around trying to catch and get rid of predators, which is a good thing right, nobody likes them. But the methods used are not only reporting them, that isn't good enough when banning is IP and/or HWID banning on OCCASSION and not every time. So it doesn't really help, these groups will do the things you hear of, doxxing, crashing, swatting, etc. this is obviously bad, even I will say that being what and who I am. This is going way too far and standards of these groups are being raised to more illegal things by the day, this has gone far beyond the hacked clients and such, this is a problem of children doing illegal things. Because of people like kozutoh posting youtube videos about malicious activities, it has made it more accessible for kids around the ages of 14-16 to get into, another bad thing. They just want to look cool but do not understand what they are getting themselves into.

I have offered numerous times to work with the VRChat team to prevent this because if anyone can give them advice, it's going to be someone with reputation in the community.

If there is anyone part of the staff team reading this, please, take it into consideration and speak with me. I have no ill intent and have shown it many times in the past few years with you. I've stopped you from getting stream sniped, world crashed and getting your accounts logged in a rifle program.

The main source of this problem is children being preyed upon by older men and women.

Another point I have, why would worlds like Just H Party or FBT Heaven EVER be allowed on the front pages of VRChat for beginner users to see? This should not be something new players should be getting into at all, there's not necessarily a problem with it but when you are immediately showing new players that you have clubs like that in the game, it affects their first impression of the game.

I will expand more on stuff like this more often but I have typed a lot in this post so again, please consider taking some pointers from me. This has been a long thought out message from the entire malicious community that you guys have decided not to listen to because you think they are all malicious because they want to be bad. That's not the case.

Thank you for reading my yap session.
title: Age Verifying
